$description: Motion tokens (DTCG). Durations + easing curves for component transitions. Added 2026-06-19 from the Tabs fitness test (Route A) — first motion tokens in the store; reference these from component `motion` blocks rather than hard-coding timings. Reduced-motion handling is a component rule, not a token.

standard.$description: primary moving elements (e.g. tab selected-indicator slide)

press.$description: tactile/scale-physics press depress — snappy, no overshoot (ease-out). Added 2026-06-22 with Button Refined scale-physics.

spring.$description: scale-physics grow toward cursor + release; pairs with easing/spring overshoot. Added 2026-06-22.
overshoot for scale-physics grow/settle (Button Refined; promoted 2026-06-22). Use sparingly — see _MOTION-THEMES.md theme 2 (Settle).

out.$description: CSS ease-out — snappy press release, pairs with duration/press
